question: How much is the maintenance plan?
reference_answer: The Comfort Club costs $189 a year per system or $16.99 a month (12-month minimum), $99 per additional system. It includes two seasonal tune-ups a year, priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived, 15% off repairs and no after-hours dispatch fee. Comfort Club Plus is $269 a year and adds a water heater flush and inspection, a plumbing inspection and 15% off plumbing repairs.

question: Can I upgrade from the regular plan to the Plus plan mid-year?
reference_answer: Yes. Standard members can upgrade to Comfort Club Plus at any time; the $80 difference is prorated for the months left in the current term.

question: I think I got charged twice. There are two $1240 charges on my card from you guys.
reference_answer: One of the two charges is usually a pending authorization that drops off in 3 to 5 business days. If both charges post, Meridian opens a case with its payment processor.

question: I'm a member. Do I get a discount on a new system?
reference_answer: Comfort Club members (Standard and Plus) get $500 off a full system replacement. Replacements start with a free in-home estimate.

question: I got an email saying my membership is renewing. When does it actually charge? And I can still cancel before then?
reference_answer: Yes. Members can cancel auto-renewal at any time before the renewal date. An annual plan bills once on the enrollment date and renews on the same date each year.

question: I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
reference_answer: A full system installation has a 2-year Meridian labor warranty, so a unit installed within the last year is covered; a warranty diagnostic is booked and there is no diagnostic fee if the failure is covered.

question: Does the labor warranty cover a repeat repair? You fixed my blower in March and it's doing the same thing.
reference_answer: Repairs carry a 1-year labor warranty on the specific part repaired; if the same part fails within a year, the return visit and labor are free.

question: Two things. My AC is blowing warm and I want to get someone out, and I want to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.
reference_answer: Comfort Club Standard is $189 a year per system (or $16.99 a month). Members have the $89 diagnostic fee waived and get 15% off repairs (parts and labor), plus two seasonal tune-ups a year. The documents don't say whether those benefits apply to a visit booked on the day you join, so a team member confirms that when setting up the membership.

question: We just bought a house and the previous owner had a system installed by you. Does the warranty transfer?
reference_answer: Manufacturer parts warranties can transfer once to a new homeowner, usually within 90 days of the sale, with a manufacturer transfer fee of $50 to $100. Meridian's labor warranty does not transfer.

question: What does the Comfort Club membership actually include? And how much is it? Does it cover plumbing?
reference_answer: The Comfort Club costs $189 a year per system or $16.99 a month (12-month minimum), $99 per additional system. It includes two seasonal tune-ups a year, priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived, 15% off repairs and no after-hours dispatch fee. Comfort Club Plus is $269 a year and adds a water heater flush and inspection, a plumbing inspection and 15% off plumbing repairs.

question: My system is 18 years old and I'm thinking about replacing it. What would that cost?
reference_answer: Replacements start with a free in-home estimate from a Comfort Advisor; a full residential split system typically costs $8,000 to $16,000 installed, depending on tonnage, efficiency rating, ductwork condition and brand.

question: My Trane compressor died and the system is only three years old. Is that under warranty? How much is labor on a compressor?
reference_answer: If the unit is registered, the manufacturer covers the compressor part for 10 years. The standard 2-year Meridian installation labor warranty has ended for a 3-year-old system, so labor is billable unless the customer was a Comfort Club member when it was installed (members get a 5-year labor warranty, which staff confirm); compressor replacement labor typically runs $600 to $900, confirmed by the technician on site.

question: Did you guys register my new unit with the, uh, manufacturer? I never got anything.
reference_answer: Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of installation; registration is required for the full parts warranty term.

question: What appointment windows do you have?
reference_answer: 8am to 12pm, 12pm to 4pm and 1pm to 5pm, plus 4pm to 7pm on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

question: Can I pay by card over the phone?
reference_answer: Card numbers are never taken over the phone; Meridian sends a secure payment link by text or email, valid for 24 hours.

question: Are you open on Thanksgiving?
reference_answer: Closed on Thanksgiving (November 26 and 27); the emergency line is open, and holiday emergency dispatch is $199.

question: Do you service Manor?
reference_answer: Yes. Manor (78653) was added to the service area in April 2026.

question: How much is a tune-up?
reference_answer: A seasonal tune-up is $129 for non-members and included for Comfort Club members.

question: Is there a fee to cancel my appointment?
reference_answer: Cancelling or rescheduling more than 24 hours before the window is free; inside 24 hours there is a $49 late-cancellation fee.

question: Do you offer financing?
reference_answer: Yes, on repairs over $1,000 and all system replacements, through a financing partner; approval takes about 5 minutes.

question: How much does it cost to clear a clogged drain?
reference_answer: Drain clearing typically costs $149 to $290 depending on access; the technician confirms the final price on site.

question: Do you do duct cleaning?
reference_answer: Meridian does not do duct cleaning itself; it partners with a third party and can give a referral.

question: Do you come out to San Marcos?
reference_answer: No. San Marcos is not in the service area.

question: Is the Comfort Club still $149 a year?
reference_answer: No. It is $189 a year per system, or $16.99 a month with a 12-month minimum.

question: Are you only open until 6 on weekdays?
reference_answer: No. Phone support is Monday to Friday 7am to 7pm and Saturday 8am to 4pm.

question: Isn't the repair warranty only 90 days?
reference_answer: No. Meridian repairs carry a 1-year labor warranty on the part repaired.

question: Can I pay the technician with a check?
reference_answer: No. Technicians do not accept checks or cash; payment is by card or ACH through a secure link.

question: Does my membership move with me to my new house?
reference_answer: No. A membership stays with the service address and transfers to the next homeowner there; it does not move to a new address.

question: I heard cancellations need 48 hours notice, is that right?
reference_answer: No. Cancelling more than 24 hours before the window is free; inside 24 hours there is a $49 fee.

question: Is the diagnostic fee still $79?
reference_answer: No, the diagnostic visit is $89, credited toward a repair approved on the same visit, and waived for Comfort Club members.

question: Is the after-hours emergency fee $129?
reference_answer: No. After-hours emergency dispatch is $149, waived for Comfort Club members.
